reponse: The old method no longer works. An earlier Slack tip said to set FEATURE_FLAGS=new_dash in .env.local [1], but since PR #447 the flag is renamed dashboards_v2 and flags are served by the API, so that env variable is ignored [2]. Instead, with the API running, run `make dev-flags FLAGS=dashboards_v2`, then hard-reload the page [3]. You can verify with `curl localhost:8000/api/flags` [3]. If the tiles stay empty, the seed data may be thin [1], and new workspaces with no events show a blank grid [5].
